subject: Need quick feedback on ticket form
text:
Hi all,
Sorry this is a rushed note, but I need feedback before the next queue rotation. Practical concern: too many support tickets still arrive without the account location, the affected date, or the exact error text. That means we ask three extra questions before work starts, and the customer waits even longer. I am wondering whether we should add a short required checklist at submission, or maybe show a sample reply right below the form. I do not want to make the form feel like an interrogation, but I do want fewer back-and-forth loops. Please tell me honestly if the extra fields would annoy you or save you time. Another concern: people keep attaching screenshots without filenames, and we lose context when images expire. If we ask for a short text summary above the attachment, that might reduce confusion. Would that be annoying? Would it actually help? I also worry the required fields could push users to the chat option, and I do not want to overload chat either. Does that seem likely based on what you have seen? If you have a better fix, say it plainly. A one-line fix is welcome. A longer thought is also welcome, but keep it focused. I need to weigh form changes against possible confusion. Also, if you think the sample reply would help, let me know which version is clearest, because I am short on time to redesign the wording. Reply with just a quick sentence. I would especially appreciate any feedback by end of day, since the draft needs to be ready for review tomorrow morning. Thanks for being flexible with this quick ask.
